name: Webform send draft link
description: Adds a form to email a link to a saved webform draft, using Webform's built-in secure update token.
project_description:
Enables to send a link to a webform draft via email.

 Configuration 
 1. Visit /admin/structure/webform/manage/{WEBFORM}/settings/submissions

and check the 'Allow your users to save and finish the webform later' option.

 

 2. Check the 'Allow users to update a submission using a secure token' option.

 

 3. Scroll down to the "SEND DRAFT LINK" section and check the "Allow users to send links to drafts by email" option.

 

 Uses 
 After saving a draft, a user can open the 'Send draft link' tab and send a link. The link will be inserted to the 'Message' field.

 

 Dependencies 
 
 Webform 
 Simple Mail
